Definition: to advance, i.e. pass on or continue; causatively, to remove; specifically, to bedeck (i.e. bring an ornament upon)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pass on, advance, go on, pass by, remove; 1a) (Qal) to pass on, put on; 1b) (Hiphil) to remove
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
